methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing was collected from each provider's own pricing/subscription page on the accessed date, corroborated with dedicated 2026 pricing-review sources where the official page returned a 403, was geolocated outside the USA (rendering EUR), or sat behind a sign-in wall. monthlyUsd records the recurring per-month USD price billed annually (the headline subscription rate) unless noted; no-contract month-to-month rates and annual upfront totals are recorded in notes, and annualDiscountPct is only set where the provider publishes a clear annual discount. Quote-only tiers (e.g. Getty/Storyblocks Enterprise) carry a null price, and minutes/calls/overage fields are null throughout as they do not apply to stock-media subscriptions.

vendors.name: Shutterstock
vendors.provenance: Official shutterstock.com/pricing and /subscribe returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch, so US 2026 USD rates were taken from the StockPhotoSecrets and Photutorial 2026 Shutterstock pricing guides. monthlyUsd is the annual-billed-monthly rate; month-to-month and annual-upfront prices are in notes.

plans.name: 10 Images / month
plans.notes: 10 image downloads per month, royalty-free Standard license. $29/mo on a 12-month contract; $49/mo month-to-month; or $299/year paid upfront. Includes $10,000 legal indemnification.

plans.name: 50 Images / month
plans.notes: 50 image downloads per month. $99/mo on a 12-month contract; $125/mo month-to-month; or $979/year paid upfront.

plans.name: 350 Images / month
plans.notes: 350 image downloads per month. $169/mo on a 12-month contract; $199/mo month-to-month; or $1,649/year paid upfront.

plans.name: 750 Images / month
plans.notes: 750 image downloads per month. $199/mo on a 12-month contract; $249/mo month-to-month; or $1,999/year paid upfront.

plans.name: 5 Videos / month
plans.notes: 5 HD/4K video clip downloads per month. $99/mo on a 12-month contract; $189/mo month-to-month; or $949/year ($59/mo) paid upfront.

plans.name: Music & Sound Effects (Unlimited)
plans.notes: Unlimited music and sound-effects downloads. $49/mo on a 12-month contract; $69/mo month-to-month; or $499/year ($35/mo equivalent) paid upfront.

plans.name: Generative AI Plus
plans.notes: AI image generation: 100 generations (up to 400 AI images) per month. $7/mo billed annually; $29/mo no-contract.

vendors.name: Adobe Stock
vendors.provenance: Official stock.adobe.com/plans geolocated to Germany under WebFetch (showing EUR), so US 2026 USD rates were taken from the StockPhotoSecrets and Photutorial 2026 Adobe Stock pricing guides. monthlyUsd is the annual-billed-monthly rate; month-to-month rates are noted. A standard asset = one image/vector/template or one HD/4K video credit per the listed allowance.

plans.name: 10 Assets / month (annual)
plans.notes: 10 standard assets per month (images, vectors, templates; includes up to 1 HD/4K video). $29.99/mo on an annual plan billed monthly; $49.99/mo month-to-month. Unused downloads roll over while active.

plans.name: 40 Assets / month (annual)
plans.notes: 40 standard assets per month (includes up to 6 HD/4K videos). $79.99/mo on an annual plan billed monthly; $99.99/mo month-to-month.

plans.name: 750 Assets / month (annual)
plans.notes: 750 standard assets per month (includes up to 25 HD/4K videos). $199.99/mo on an annual plan billed monthly; $249.99/mo month-to-month.

plans.name: 5-Credit Pack (on-demand)
plans.notes: One-time credit pack (not a monthly subscription): 5 credits for $49.95 ($9.99/credit), valid 1 year. Larger packs: 40 credits $359.99, 150 credits $1,200.00. monthlyUsd null because this is a non-recurring on-demand purchase.

vendors.name: Getty Images
vendors.provenance: US 2026 USD rates taken from the Photutorial 2026 Getty Images pricing guide. Getty's annual subscription plans (Premium Access) are quote-only; published self-serve pricing is limited to UltraPacks (per-download) and AI generation packs. UltraPacks are one-time purchases so monthlyUsd is null, with the per-download price recorded in notes.

plans.name: Premium Access (subscription)
plans.notes: Customizable annual subscription for unlimited or high-volume image/video access. Quote-only: Getty does not publish a self-serve rate; pricing is negotiated with sales.

plans.name: UltraPack - Large Images / 4K Video
plans.notes: Published self-serve on-demand packs (one-time, not monthly). Large images / 4K video per-download price: single $499, 5-pack $299/dl, 10-pack $280/dl, 15-pack $250/dl. monthlyUsd null (non-recurring).

plans.name: UltraPack - Small Images / Low-res Video
plans.notes: Published self-serve on-demand packs (one-time). Small images / low-res video per-download price: single $199, 5-pack $150/dl, 10-pack $140/dl, 15-pack $130/dl. Medium-size tier sits between. monthlyUsd null (non-recurring).

plans.name: AI Generation Pack
plans.notes: Published self-serve text-to-image generation packs (one-time): 25 generations $49, 100 generations $149. monthlyUsd null (non-recurring pack).

vendors.name: iStock
vendors.provenance: Official istockphoto.com plans page geolocated to Germany under WebFetch (showing EUR), so US 2026 USD rates were taken from the Photutorial 2026 iStock pricing guide. monthlyUsd is the annual-billed-monthly rate; month-to-month rates are noted. iStock (a Getty brand) offers Basic, Premium, and Premium+Video subscription families.

plans.name: Basic - 10 downloads / month
plans.notes: 10 downloads/month from the Essentials collection (images/vectors). $29/mo annual; $40/mo month-to-month. Higher Basic tiers: 25 dl $49/mo annual, 50 dl $90/mo, 750 dl $167/mo. Unused downloads roll over while active.

plans.name: Premium - 10 downloads / month
plans.notes: 10 downloads/month with access to both Essentials and Signature collections. $70/mo annual; $99/mo month-to-month. Higher tiers: 25 dl $120/mo annual, 50 dl $199/mo, 750 dl $334/mo.

plans.name: Premium + Video - 10 downloads / month
plans.notes: 10 downloads/month including images, video, and music tracks. $99/mo annual; $149/mo month-to-month. Higher tiers: 25 dl $165/mo annual, 50 dl $265/mo.

vendors.name: Envato Elements
vendors.provenance: Official elements.envato.com/pricing geolocated to the EU under WebFetch (showing EUR), so US 2026 USD rates were taken from the CheckThat.ai 2026 Envato pricing breakdown. monthlyUsd is the annual-billed-monthly rate; month-to-month rates and annual totals are noted. All plans include unlimited downloads of 28M+ assets and a commercial license.

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: Unlimited downloads of 28M+ assets (video, photos, templates, music, graphics, fonts) plus 10 AI generations/month with a lifetime commercial license. $16.50/mo billed annually ($198/year); $39/mo month-to-month (annual saves ~58%).

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Everything in Core plus 100 AI generations/month across the AI toolkit (image, video, voice, music, graphics). $39/mo billed annually ($468/year); $59/mo month-to-month (annual saves ~34%).

plans.name: Ultimate
plans.notes: Everything in Plus plus unlimited AI generations/month across the complete AI toolkit. $109/mo billed annually ($1,308/year); $169/mo month-to-month (annual saves ~36%).

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Unlimited downloads and AI generations with custom user seats, custom licensing, dedicated account manager, and invoicing. Quote-only: contact sales required, no published rate.

vendors.name: Storyblocks
vendors.provenance: Official storyblocks.com/pricing geolocated to the EU under WebFetch (showing EUR), so US 2026 USD rates were taken from the CheckThat.ai 2026 Storyblocks pricing breakdown. monthlyUsd is the annual-billed-monthly rate (Storyblocks publishes only annual billing); all consumer plans include unlimited downloads.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Unlimited downloads of 8K/4K/HD video, templates, photos and vectors, plus 3,000 AI credits/month. $21/mo billed annually ($252/year). No standalone month-to-month rate.

plans.name: Unlimited All Access
plans.notes: Everything in Essentials plus the full music library (50,000+ tracks) and sound effects (42,000+), with 4,500 AI credits/month. Unlimited downloads. $30/mo billed annually ($360/year). Most popular tier.

plans.name: Small Business
plans.notes: All Unlimited All Access content plus business licensing and 6,000 AI credits/month. Unlimited downloads. $40/mo billed annually ($480/year).

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Multi-user access, $1M indemnification, perpetual rights, and API access. Quote-only: contact sales required, no published rate.

vendors.name: Depositphotos
vendors.provenance: Official depositphotos.com/subscription page returned a sign-in wall to WebFetch, so US 2026 USD rates were taken from the Photutorial 2026 Depositphotos review. monthlyUsd is the annual-billed-monthly rate; month-to-month rates and annual upfront totals are noted.

plans.name: Images - 30 downloads / month (annual)
plans.notes: 30 image (JPEG/vector) downloads per month, annual plan billed monthly ($0.19-$1.44 per image). $29/mo annual; the comparable 25-download month-to-month plan is $36/mo. 75/150/750 download tiers also offered. Unused downloads roll over (except the 750 tier).

plans.name: Video - 5 downloads / month
plans.notes: Video subscription starting at $67/mo for 5 downloads, with tiers up to 25 downloads/month.

plans.name: Audio (Unlimited)
plans.notes: Unlimited audio/music downloads. $12.99/mo, or $129/year ($10.75/mo equivalent) billed upfront.

vendors.name: Pond5
vendors.provenance: Official pond5.com/subscriptions page was not directly fetchable; US 2026 USD subscription rates were taken from Footage Secrets' coverage of Pond5's current small-volume subscription tiers (introduced Aug 2024, updated Aug 2025). monthlyUsd is the month-to-month rate; annual totals and the yearly discount are noted. Each plan includes 10 downloads/month with an Individual license.

plans.name: Music
plans.notes: 10 music-track downloads/month from 1.5M tracks, Individual license. $25/mo month-to-month; $150/year ($12.50/mo, ~50% off) plus 10% off assets outside the subscription.

plans.name: Music & SFX
plans.notes: 10 downloads/month from 1.5M music tracks plus 1.7M sound effects, Individual license. $30/mo month-to-month; $180/year ($15/mo, ~50% off) plus 10% off out-of-plan assets.

plans.name: Footage Plus
plans.notes: 10 downloads/month from 4.2M HD & 4K videos plus a selection of 12M+ images, 3D models, AE templates, and the full music/SFX libraries. $199/mo month-to-month; $999/year ($83.25/mo, ~50% off) plus 10% off out-of-plan assets.
